purpose: Three shared-style primitive low-poly kiosk advertising posters; one unique print per kiosk, on both side walls.
style: Large angular flat shapes, muted limited palette, rough Russian block lettering; no photographic objects, gloss or realistic detail.

runs.prompt: Redraw the entire attached advertising poster in the SAME very primitive LOW POLY illustrated style for a muted low-poly video game. This must be a radically simplified flat drawing: only large angular polygon shapes, 2 or 3 hard flat colour facets per object, a very limited faded palette, rough plain block Cyrillic lettering. Think an awkward cheaply hand-painted village kiosk sign translated into the coarse polygon language of PS1 game props. Absolutely NO photographic objects, NO realistic glass, NO realistic food, NO photographic textures, NO specular highlights, NO gloss, NO 3D render, NO gradients, NO bevelled letters, NO drop shadows, NO micro-detail. Simplify a bottle to 6-8 large polygons, a beer mug to 8-12 large polygons, each pie to an angular oval with just 2 dark score marks. Only 3 main product shapes, lots of flat empty paper. No detailed filling, no small bubbles. No distressed texture except at most a few broad scuffs. Opaque flat portrait 2:3 print-ready image, page fills frame, no board mockup/perspective. Preserve ONLY the Russian product words and the general product hierarchy from the reference, replace every visual element. All lettering should be primitive, slightly clumsy, readable, one colour and flat. Text exactly once each: "ПИВО", "ВОДКА", "ПИРОЖКИ". No other text, slogans, logos, numbers, people or watermarks. All 3 posters must look like one matching crude flat illustrated series. Variant1. Large "ПИВО" at top, crude angular yellow beer mug central, a small grey-green vodka bottle and one ochre angular pie below, flat "ВОДКА" and "ПИРОЖКИ" at bottom. Muted mustard, dark bottle green, dirty cream, tiny dull brick-red accent. Paper flat dirty cream. No radial burst. Very restrained, extremely simple graphic.
